# InkControl / 墨控

> Hisense A5 Pro 经典版 (Classic Edition), monochrome E-ink. Private repository. All compilation and build tests run on GitHub-hosted Actions. Read AGENTS.md before work.

## Invariants

All 88 enhancements default off. Preserve IDs, defaults, and grayscale/binary separation. Video selection is independent. New signing starts at rc13; old signatures cannot be updated in place. The recorded device still runs rc10 + rc10-gpu-fix1. Runtime acknowledgement, standalone GPU comparison, panel feedback, and long-term validation are separate evidence levels. Raw inputs, logs, backups and signing secrets stay outside Git. Documentation work and CI do not authorize device changes.
